emergency.title: Power Cut — What To Do Right Now
emergency.step1_desc: Unplug large appliances. Check your breaker panel — a tripped breaker may be the cause
emergency.step2_desc: Check your utility provider's Telegram channel or website for outage schedules
emergency.step3_desc: Use a powerbank. Your phone is your lifeline for communication and information
emergency.step4_desc: Use a flashlight or headlamp — not candles (fire safety)
emergency.step5_desc: Unopened: fridge stays safe for 4 hours, freezer up to 48 hours
